I have resolved the issue by updating [`Prefetch`](file:///testbed/django/db/models/query.py#L2142) in `django/db/models/query.py`.

### Cause
When a sliced queryset (e.g. `Post.objects.all()[:3]`) was passed into `Prefetch`, it was accepted without validation at instantiation time. When the prefetch query executed, it attempted to filter the queryset with the primary key lookup of related instances (`queryset.filter(...)`), failing with `AssertionError` (or `TypeError` in Django 4.0+) because queries cannot be filtered once a slice has been taken.

### Solution
Added a validation check in [`Prefetch.__init__`](file:///testbed/django/db/models/query.py#L2143-L2158) to disallow sliced querysets (`queryset.query.is_sliced`), raising a `ValueError("Prefetch querysets cannot use slices.")` consistently with other invalid `Prefetch` querysets.
